pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal regions with jagged, stellate margins. Edge angularity is high with moderate-to-sharp pixel gradients. Patch area is larger and more elongated on the upper flank, becoming smaller and more fragmented toward the extremities.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous topological graph of light-colored pelage. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial and quadri-radial. Pathways maintain a relatively consistent pixel thickness across the torso, forming a well-defined negative-space web.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrated 1D contour along the upper neck and shoulder. The mane presents as a short, uniform, brush-like silhouette against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: Partial occlusion of the primary subject's lower-right chest and foreleg area by the head and neck of a secondary giraffe individual.
